text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. As artificial intelligence becomes part of our daily lives, we must think about how it affects people. One major problem is bias. If the data used to train AI is unfair, the system can make unfair decisions about jobs, loans, or healthcare. Fairness means treating everyone equally, regardless of their background. Privacy is also a serious concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies must protect this data and use it responsibly. Transparency matters too: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building systems that are safe, honest, and helpful for society. Governments, companies, and users all share this responsibility.
